testResults.name: screener-ui-contract-tests
testResults.result: 47 passed across 7 files: filter builder add/remove/edit payload correctness (buildFilters JSON assertions), validation mirroring backend FilterError semantics blocking invalid runs, round-trip hydration of saved definitions, summaries, HTTP-error mapping, script lint cases, and the fixture-translation proof that listScreeners emits real ScreenerSavedDefinitions

testResults.name: type-and-build-gates
testResults.result: svelte-check 0 errors 0 warnings; production build succeeds with the rebuilt screener page (FilterBuilder, PythonScreenerEditor, SavedStudies, ScreenerResultsTable)

limitations: The HTTP run/save contract carries declarative filters only; the Python editor provides client-side feedback and renders server lint errors until the T229 sandbox gains a program field on the run contract
No DELETE route exists for saved screeners; deletion is deferred until the backend adds it
api.ts's frozen legacy translator mangles real-shaped fixture rows, so fixtures carry translator-input vocabulary; pass-through is an api.ts-owner follow-up
